Container.Name: Cerious-AASM
Container.Overview:
Cerious AASM is a self-hosted Ark: Survival Ascended server manager with a web interface. It manages dedicated ARK server installations using SteamCMD/Proton and provides server configuration and management from your browser.
This Unraid template uses host networking so game, query, peer, and RCON ports can be managed directly on the Unraid host without maintaining large Docker port mappings.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: ARK ASA Ark Survival Ascended server manager AASM SteamCMD Proton game server
Container.Requires: An x86-64 Unraid server with Docker enabled. Internet access is required to pull the container image and download/update dedicated server files. Host networking is used for game-server connectivity.
Container.Changes:
2026-09-28: - Added PUID, PGID and UMASK. The container now takes ownership of the appdata folders, including nested folders, and runs as nobody:users (99:100) by default. Fixes "permission denied" errors at startup. Requires Cerious AASM 1.2.1 or newer.
2026-09-27: - Initial Unraid Community Applications template. - Separated persistent data and configuration directories. - Added official Cerious AASM application icon.

Config.Name: AASM Data
Config.Description: Persistent Cerious AASM application data, SteamCMD files, ARK server installations, saves, and server configuration.

Config.Name: AASM Config
Config.Description: Persistent Cerious AASM application configuration and logs.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID that owns the appdata folders and runs the app. 99 is Unraid's nobody user.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID that owns the appdata folders and runs the app. 100 is Unraid's users group.

Config.Name: UMASK
Config.Description: Permissions mask for files the app creates. 000 matches Unraid's other appdata containers.

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: Port used by the Cerious AASM web interface. Host networking exposes this port directly on the Unraid host.

Config.Name: Authentication Enabled
Config.Description: Enable Cerious AASM web authentication. Enter true or false.

Config.Name: Username
Config.Description: Username used when Cerious AASM web authentication is enabled.

Config.Name: Password
Config.Description: Password used when Cerious AASM web authentication is enabled.

Config.Name: Network Mode Indicator
Config.Description: Tells Cerious AASM that Docker is using host networking.
